note_nb: Dialogtider er målt fra de ferdige opptakene: start/slutt for tale, i sekunder fra starten av hvert klipp. Stille undersøkelsestekst styres av interaksjon. VHS-tider er kun planlagte.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Check the survey reference before the unattended run. Write down anything you have to change, even if it fixes itself.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: The camera is beside the east door. Take a reference before you touch the fault.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: And try your way out while the lights are good. A door on a plan is no use if you have never opened it.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The lamp, its reflection and the dark glass agree when you change the light. This is an ordinary reference.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The notebook records the doors you actually opened. Untried routes stay unmarked.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: One route is still untested. Check the door from this side; the drawing alone does not show whether it opens.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: The complaint is about the inspection lamp. Just that lamp.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Use the marked service control outside the fence. Leave the locked equipment alone.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Watch the lamp and the indicator separately. Tell me whether they agree.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The inspection lamp follows its local control. The separate indicator agrees with the service test.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The complaint can be explained here. This does not establish the power state of the whole town.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The readings do not agree yet. Calibration can continue. Complete and file the lamp inspection, then follow the agreed safety work; do not restart an isolated automatic schedule.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The residual has a time of its own: 00:13:47. The earlier service complaint does not explain it.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Mark one detail on FRAME 01 that you can check at B-12. Change one local condition, then expose again.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The local condition changed. The marked reference remains on the controlled print.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: File what the two exposures support. The next question is where B-12 got that reference.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The controlled detail is not readable on this copy. Keep the negative and print it again with the darkroom shut.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: The service drawer has a spare. Brass tag, OFFICE. I should have put it in the handover.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: Take the field folder. I wrote down where I stood so somebody else could try it.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: I saw the same shape from two places. I do not know whether it was looking at me.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Dale's field index identifies the culvert camera place. The separate array service card describes a different controlled comparison. Neither record is the result of a test you have not performed.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The archive gives STATION 01 a separate history. Dale has not identified the person in the old record.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The field folder gives you the post and the standing place. Hold them against the actual view before you record a result. The tape is optional.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: E09A fixes A against the transit and B. C is a separate closing sight line.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The empty footing and the marked post can be photographed together. Check them before deciding what moved.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The culvert camera place belongs to T02. The separate array service comparison concerns its own operator places; do not treat the two records as the same geometry.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The empty footing and moved A-post resolve against the fixed transit references. C remains a separate sight line. The earlier array comparison is a distinct controlled observation.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The cut faces and the covered lamp answer separate questions. Neither identifies who cut the cable.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The receiver repeats the 1947 correction at the same place in the fragment. Take the record and field prints to Nora Vega.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The lamp follow-up remains unresolved. Keep that limit on the card. The cable record, timing record and trip to Nora remain available.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: [Field receiver: "Reference west. No. East. Hold the last reading."]

lines.speaker: NORA
lines.text: Tomás was my brother. Nineteen. He checked the reading twice before he wrote it down.

lines.speaker: NORA
lines.text: Yes. I cut it. The lamp was off. The reference stayed.

lines.speaker: NORA
lines.text: What you heard is what he said then. I have asked it other things. It gives me the same words.

lines.speaker: NORA
lines.text: C ran east from STATION 01. The old road crosses it at a bolt in the shoulder.

lines.speaker: NORA
lines.text: Keep the original where somebody can read it. I tried leaving out a line. It did not make the place go away.

lines.speaker: NORA
lines.text: Don't finish his observation. Get the originals to the courier, and don't stop at C.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The letter and the field card are still on the table. Ask about the missing part before leaving.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Bring the original run off the rack. Keep the receiver copy with it.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Hondo and Site 11 are sending their local records. I want the records, not three accounts of the same broadcast.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The ventilation stops. A white band moves across the outside wall. You can still see the doorway and the floor.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The local lamp is off. The band still crosses the glass, and the opaque screen cuts it off.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: It searched one room earlier. Now the outside band is closing the exits as the visitor moves. The recorded fragment has not changed.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: A photograph is not required. If the original was not secured, return to the covered checkpoint before the inspection and collect it before the encounter starts. Do not go back through an active search for another sheet.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The band is moving toward the next window. The wall between the windows stays dark.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The service route is behind the screen. The front yard is in the light.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Caught inside SARO.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Resume from before the inspection. The findings already secured are kept.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The original is secured in the truck. The visitor has lost contact. Its search has ended.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Hondo kept its power when you lost yours. Their paper is a local record. Do not put your outage on their chart.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Site 11 took the second reading with the audio feed unplugged. Their transit still recorded it.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Compare the times and the order. Then tell me what is observation and what is your explanation.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The local source sheets agree on phase order and measured interval. Their separate optical readings show continuing approach.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The warning can state coordinated preparation for an arrival. Identity and purpose remain unestablished. Call Ward and keep those limits on the report.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: One remote source is not verified. Send the local warning now, then ask Ward for the original source sheet before recording a network conclusion.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The source sheets contain different local readings. Their sequence and timing agree.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Hondo and Site 11 each recorded approaching tracks after the reference sweep. SARO is one prepared place among several.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The records support a warning about a coordinated arrival. They do not identify who is coming.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: The network warning is entered. The six o'clock series remains suspended after your earlier report. The other sites have read it back: nobody closes a reference or completes a run.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Reading back: SARO zero-seven original run, Hondo local sheet, Site Eleven local sheet. First boundary, oh-three-fifty-six and eight seconds. That is in my dated log. The warning is outside SARO; keep the photographs and originals with their sheets.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: The field courier is on the old Roswell road, east of the mapped reference. Check the map at the diner before you agree a handover point.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The framed clipping by the door is the old one, July 1947. It is a photograph of a place, not a measurement.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Ward has the warning. What is left is the map: where C meets the old road, and where the courier can wait beyond it.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: On the table the tracing is still loose. Place its transit on STATION 01, north to north. The framed newspaper clipping has no survey scale.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: C is the bolt at eight point one five. The handover is ten point four. I have both marked.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: The old road is the direct approach to the courier. It is a practical route, not a finding that the reference is safe.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Take the originals through. Stay in the cab, keep moving and take no reading at the bolt. If the truck falters before the crossing, turn back while you can.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: C is not placed yet. Put the transit on STATION 01 first. Keep the old framed clipping beside the map; it establishes the photograph, not the crossing.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The originals are in the cab. Ward has the warning, the three source IDs and the first boundary time.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Handover: mile 10.4. C: mile 8.15. Pass the reference without stopping or taking a reading.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Leave for the handover when you are ready.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: At the crossing the engine stops. You did not turn the key off.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The warning has already gone through. The originals are beside you.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The warning has not been acknowledged. Use the diner payphone before leaving.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Something struck the outside of the glass. The marks are on that side. Switching the room lamp does not remove them.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Secure the known door. You can report what you saw without going outside after it.

lines.speaker: DISPATCH
lines.text: SARO control-room window. Something struck the outside of the glass and left marks. I have your time and location.

lines.speaker: DISPATCH
lines.text: Stay behind a secured door if you can. Call us if the person enters the building. This report is open; I cannot say who was out there.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: A pale body stands between the service front and SARO 07. It turns towards a new sound. The opaque shed wall breaks the view.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The route outside the fence goes around the shed. Watch the open crossing before you move. The high-voltage yard is not an exit.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The search has moved away from the route you used. The truck starts. Your completed lamp test is still on the service card.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Caliche has a working phone and people. Report the encounter and ask for someone to meet you.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Return to cover before the crossing. The lamp inspection is preserved. Read the search before trying the truck again.

lines.speaker: DISPATCH
lines.text: Caliche Junction service front. A tall pale person moved while you were watching and turned towards new sound. You reached your truck.

lines.speaker: DISPATCH
lines.text: Dr. Ward has a relief technician coming to the Caliche fuel stop. Wait in view of the counter until the contact is identified.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Mara Ortiz, district maintenance. White utility wagon, number twenty-three. She will meet you at the fuel station, in view of the counter.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Tell her what you saw before you discuss equipment. She is there to bring help, not to send you back into a yard alone.

lines.speaker: ORTIZ
lines.text: Mara Ortiz, district maintenance. Wagon twenty-three. That's my card. Dr. Ward said you'd be by the pumps.

lines.speaker: ORTIZ
lines.text: Forty minutes of washboard road to get out here. Fine. Tell me what you actually saw, not what you think it was.

lines.speaker: ORTIZ
lines.text: All right. We write that down from here. Nobody needs you any closer to that yard tonight.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Light struck wagon twenty-three. Ortiz rose clear of the ground with nothing under her, hung there a moment, and was gone. Her thermos rolled out across the asphalt.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: At the edge of the light, several pale figures stood completely still. One of them turned its head towards you.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: You are behind cover now. There was nothing you could have reached. Call it in from the working phone.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Wagon twenty-three is empty, the driver's door open. Ortiz's thermos lies against the kerb with her name on a strip of tape.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Narrow marks are pressed into the gravel by the wagon and lead nowhere. The wagon, the thermos and the marks show what remained. None of them explains where she went.

lines.speaker: DISPATCH
lines.text: Mara Ortiz, district maintenance. Last seen at the Caliche fuel stop beside wagon twenty-three. You saw her lifted in a light and then could no longer see her.

lines.speaker: DISPATCH
lines.text: That is now a missing-person report, linked to your earlier call. The deputy is on his way to you. Stay where you are and leave her things where they lie.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: The SARO six o'clock observer series is suspended. I have recorded that as a local order. Dispatch has Ortiz's case.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Nobody is asking you to carry on a normal shift. Stay with the deputy and give him what the case needs.

lines.speaker: DEPUTY
lines.text: Your outfit up the road runs a receiver all night. Was it on at nine o'clock?

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: It was. The SARO receiver has been on passive monitoring since the shift began.

lines.speaker: DEPUTY
lines.text: Then I want its log and the strip chart from nine for this report. You have the keys. I'll follow you up to the gate.

lines.speaker: DEPUTY
lines.text: That's my radio. They want me back at the wagon.

lines.speaker: DEPUTY
lines.text: The receiver log and the strip chart from nine o'clock. Bring whatever else that case will need, and lock the door behind you. I'll be back up this road.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Inside: the receiver log and strip chart, the shift journal and the T01 card. Lock the automatic schedule so nothing runs while nobody is here.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The local automatic schedule is isolated. The receiver still monitors passively, and a separately authorised service check remains possible.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The receiver log and strip chart from 21:00, the shift journal and the T01 card are secured for the missing-person report. T01 is filed here, once. Turning off a local schedule has not turned off the sky.

lines.speaker: DALE
lines.text: The camera is beside the east door. Take a reference before you touch the fault.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The solid wall broke the view. Behind the closed door, the search stayed at your last position while you used the longer passage.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Contact is broken and the search has withdrawn. The secured records are still with you.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The ordinary radio drew the figure towards the new sound. From cover you saw it leave the shorter crossing.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: You crossed while the route was clear. Contact is broken and the search has withdrawn.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The schedule and records remain secured. Return to the last covered point before the intrusion and choose a clear route.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: I have you on the control-room line. Keep the door locked. The deputy is still at Ortiz's wagon; I am staying on this call.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Read me the receiver log's heading and the nine o'clock entry. That is what the missing-person report needs. Leave the automatic schedule locked.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Stay in cover until he can come back for you. Leave the receiver on passive. Nothing runs on its own tonight.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: 00:13:47. A new residual appears in passive reception. The isolated automatic schedule has not resumed.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Use the existing receiver controls and preserve the print. The body at the junction and what took Ortiz are separate observations; this test asks what the signal retains.

lines.speaker: EARL
lines.text: That date is on my off-air reel. Nineteen eighty-one. I kept the station log with it.

lines.speaker: EARL
lines.text: This is fourteen-twenty AM, the town station. Your fourteen-twenty-point-four-zero-five receiver is different equipment. Let us keep the sources straight.

lines.speaker: EARL
lines.text: The reel box, the off-air entry and my initials belong together. The transmitter was shut down; that does not by itself tell us what made the sound.

lines.speaker: EARL
lines.text: The marked source switch has two positions. Tape is this reel with the monitor feed disconnected. Live is tonight's monitor with the deck disconnected.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: TAPE is selected. The live monitor is disconnected from the playback path. The dated reel supplies the old fragment.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: This establishes the source of this playback. It does not identify the source of the original sound or measure a bearing.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: LIVE MONITOR is selected. The reel deck is disconnected from this path. What you hear now belongs to tonight's monitor.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: A match in sound is not a shared source record. Keep tonight's monitor and the labelled reel separate.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The isolated reel repeats the same old fragment after a new question. The recorded words have not answered it.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The dated local reel is a separately preserved source. Record the source and timing. Direction still needs fixed landmarks and field observations.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Earl has left. In the lobby, a labelled envelope holds his dated source copy, the off-air log copy and the marked playback-disconnection sheet.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: You checked the copy on the isolated lobby deck. Its old fragment stays unchanged after your question. There is no new live reply from Earl.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: This is a checked copy of the identified source, not a claim to have handled the original reel. Keep that limit on the record.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The source or signal path is not verified. Ask for the labelled off-air log and use the isolated playback position. A familiar sound alone is not the check.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The separate array service card marks A / ROW 1 WEST, B / ROW 1 EAST and REF / R1. It describes an ordinary comparison, not what the array will follow.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: Identify the nearby dishes and check their command history. Leave the reference lamp fixed. Choose either operator place first, then the other, then return briefly.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The nearby dish identifiers match the local command and drive record you checked. The automatic schedule remains isolated; this is a separate bounded service check.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The reference lamp stays at REF / R1 at the same setting. Move yourself, not the lamp. Compare the dishes against the fixed Row One landmarks.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: At A / ROW 1 WEST, the observed dishes turn towards this operator position. REF / R1 and the fixed landmarks have not moved. Record what you actually see from here.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: At B / ROW 1 EAST, the observed dishes turn towards this operator position. The reference lamp is still at REF / R1. Compare their angles against the same landmarks.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: On your short return to the first operator place, the dishes turn back towards it. The response follows your chosen route, not a fixed order of stations.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The physical response followed the operator between two places and back while the reference lamp stayed fixed. The separate command record does not account for those changes.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: That is a result for this controlled path. It does not establish anyone's identity, a county-wide safe route or what happened to Tomás. STATION 01 records an older arrangement to examine next.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: You used the clear passage and broke contact behind opaque cover. The searching figure has withdrawn. The completed comparison is preserved.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The dishes hold briefly on the empty place you left. Then they return to 026. Nobody is standing there now.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The command, source and geometry checks are preserved. Resume from the covered point before the passage was searched; choose a clear retreat.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The comparison is incomplete. Keep the fixed lamp in place, check the other marked position and return to the first. Do not record a tracking result without the geometry and command checks.

lines.speaker: DEPUTY
lines.text: Drove the loop at half past three. Nothing on the road. It's on the sheet.

lines.speaker: DESCRIPTION
lines.text: The patrol sheet is dated and timed in his hand: 03:30, north road and old Roswell road, no obstruction. One drive, an hour ago. It promises nothing about the road now.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: The deputy's sheet puts one clear drive on that road at half past three. I have its time in the log. It is one report, not a map of everywhere it is safe.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: The courier is confirmed at bolt ten-point-four, beyond the mapped C crossing at eight-point-one-five. Carry the originals. No stopping or new reading at C.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: The warning and the three source IDs are already outside SARO. You can stay at the diner; the handover keeps the originals together. It is not a new experiment.
